dimensions.assessment: Affects federal mapping agencies, researchers, and industries dependent on critical mineral and subsurface resource data.
dimensions.evidence: improve the characterization of critical mineral, geothermal, natural hydrogen, and other subsurface resource systems

dimensions.assessment: Continues an existing geological mapping and resource assessment program with modernized technological updates.
dimensions.evidence: reauthorize the Earth Mapping Resources Initiative, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Extends program authorization for five years without detailing new specific funding amounts in the text provided.
Amends the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act to update program purpose language, integrate the 3D Hydrography Program, and extend dates.
dimensions.evidence: Section 40201(c)(1) of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act is amended

dimensions.assessment: Extends authorization for a 5-year period covering fiscal years 2027 through 2031.

missing_information: Specific funding levels or appropriations authorized for the reauthorization period are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: Reauthorizes the Earth Mapping Resources Initiative (Earth MRI) through fiscal year 2031 and expands data integration capabilities, continuing existing geological survey programs.
